title: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Comprehensive government health service for eligible Central Government employees, pensioners and specified beneficiary categories, including outpatient care, medicines, investigations and hospitalization through CGHS facilities and empanelled providers.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Serving and retired Central Government employees, eligible family members and other categories notified under CGHS rules; eligibility depends on employment/retirement status and covered location.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
